BiblicalUsage: Rîyphâh is how the Bible says (only plural), grits (as pounded). It stands in 2 Samuel 17:19, "…the well's mouth, and spread ground corn thereon…", and in Proverbs 27:22, "…shouldest bray a fool in a mortar among…".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe rîyphâh is worth knowing, because nothing in Scripture is there by accident.
